housing: Vancouver renters live in older purpose-built apartment buildings, condo units rented from owners, and secondary suites in houses.

localRules.text: In British Columbia the landlord and tenant must do a condition inspection at move-in and at move-out, using form RTB-27 or one with the same terms.

climate: Vancouver is very rainy, so check for leaks, mould and condensation around windows and in basement suites.
fact: Many Vancouver rentals are basement or laneway suites in houses.
